clue.text: Bums bared, pretty Italian nurses run for cover

indicators.note: bared means stripped, so the word bums loses its outside letters
nurses means holds or cradles, so the Italian word takes the next letter inside it

parts.note: bella is Italian for pretty
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone sunbathing with an Italian beauty dashes off for shelter when the nurses arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: An umbrella is a canopy held up as protection from rain or sun, a form of cover.

clue.text: After having work done, elder aunt's no different

indicators.note: after having work done suggests cosmetic surgery, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: An older relative has had cosmetic surgery yet looks just the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Unaltered means unchanged, the same as before.

clue.text: Very popular bar more insolvent?

parts.note: to block is to bar
bust means insolvent, so buster is jokingly more bust

explanation.surface: A very successful pub that is nonetheless going broke.
explanation.definitionFit: A blockbuster is a huge commercial hit, used to describe something hugely successful.

clue.text: Pigs in the middle fear empty troughs

indicators.note: in the middle means take the central letters of fear
empty means remove the inside, leaving only the first and last letters of troughs

explanation.surface: Pigs are scared because their troughs are bare.
explanation.definitionFit: To pig is to eat greedily, so pigs means gorges or consumes food.

clue.text: Monarch given reception by county's cavalry

indicators.note: being received by means going inside the county name

parts.note: Lancs is the short form of Lancashire, an English county
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A queen is welcomed by a county's mounted troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Lancers were cavalry soldiers armed with lances.

clue.text: Product stolen by courier

indicators.note: by places the stolen goods beside the courier, the courier coming first here

parts.note: UPS is the parcel delivery company
hot is slang for stolen goods

explanation.surface: Goods go missing in the hands of a delivery firm.
explanation.definitionFit: The upshot of something is its result or outcome, what it produces.

clue.text: Sally keeps minimal shortening in larder

indicators.note: keeps means the larder holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: a pantry is a larder

indicators.note: shortening means the word for minimal is cut by its last letter

parts.note: least means minimal

explanation.surface: Someone named Sally stores some cooking fat in the larder.
explanation.walkthrough: Shortening looks like cooking fat but tells you to cut LEAST to LEAS; Sally is a witty remark, not a name.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a quip or witty remark, and a pleasantry is a light joking remark.

clue.text: Hard like 3d

definitions.note: refers to the answer to 3 down, meaning eats

parts.note: H is the pencil grading abbreviation for hard
as means like

explanation.walkthrough: 3d is the answer to 3 down, eats; to have dinner is to eat it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have food is to consume it, so the word means eats.

clue.text: Note you hear someone singing

indicators.note: you hear says the word for note is taken by its spoken sound

parts.note: a tenner is a ten-pound banknote

explanation.surface: Picking out a note from a performer's voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenor is a male singer with a high voice.

clue.text: Bars east of Nice start to shut after work

indicators.note: after places the first letter of shut following the work

parts.note: est is French for east, the language of Nice
op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: start to means take the first letter of shut

explanation.surface: Pubs on the eastern side of Nice begin to close once work is done.
explanation.definitionFit: To estop is a legal term meaning to bar or preclude someone from a claim.

clue.text: 12d or so a boy kept handy

parts.note: or so means approximately, about
twelve old pence made one shilling, written 1s, read as ONE S
a as in 'ten pounds a day' means per
a boy is a son

explanation.surface: A lad keeps a shilling or thereabouts within reach.
explanation.walkthrough: 12d is not a cross-reference here but twelve pence in pre-decimal British money (d for penny), which was one shilling, 1s.
explanation.definitionFit: Something carried on one's body is within reach at all times, so the idiom describes being handy.

clue.text: Occupant of dirty kennel?

indicators.note: occupant of says the answer lives inside the following words, running across them

explanation.surface: Asking who might live in a grubby dog house.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyke is a mongrel dog, just the sort of creature to live in a dirty kennel.

clue.text: Playing field correctly positioned for football, right? Think again

parts.note: a rec is a recreation ground, a public playing field
a footballer who is onside is legally placed, not offside

explanation.surface: Questioning whether a pitch is properly set up for a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To reconsider is to review a decision and possibly change it.

clue.text: Scruffy beauty was merry after shaving head

indicators.note: after puts the shaved word following the beauty

parts.note: a dish is an attractive person

indicators.note: shaving head means removing the first letter

parts.note: revelled means made merry

explanation.surface: A good-looking reveller ends up unkempt after a shave.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishevelled means untidy in appearance, synonym for scruffy.

clue.text: Try on bishop's hat, a job for a sucker

parts.note: a go is a try
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop, plus the S of the possessive
a topper is a top hat

explanation.surface: Trying on a bishop's headgear looks like a fool's errand.
explanation.walkthrough: A gobstopper is a large hard round sweet that lasts a long time when sucked.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweet is made to be sucked slowly, so it is work for someone who sucks.

clue.text: Loud section of hymn repeated by Spooner

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped opening sounds, so the sounds of the word are switched around

parts.note: with of hymn, the section is the chorus, a refrain; this leaf is its first syllable, said as kaw
the rest of the word for the hymn's refrain, its second syllable

explanation.surface: A noisy part of a church song being sung again.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud the word is 'kaw-russ'; swap its K and R sounds and you get 'raw-kuss'.
explanation.definitionFit: Raucous means harsh and noisy, a synonym for loud.

clue.text: Satirist primarily turns out parodies

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so take the first letter of satirist

parts.note: ends up means turns out, finishes as

explanation.surface: A satirist's work proves to be mockery.
explanation.definitionFit: To send up something is to mock it by imitation, as a parody does.

clue.text: Quickly showing Spice Girl's back in style

indicators.note: the Spice Girl's back is her last letter, which is put in the word for style

parts.note: Posh Spice was a member of the Spice Girls pop group
taste means style

explanation.surface: A Spice Girl swiftly displays her back in a fashionable way.
explanation.walkthrough: Posh Spice was Victoria Beckham's Spice Girls nickname; her 'back' is the last letter, which shifts into the word for style rather than staying at her end.
explanation.definitionFit: Post-haste is an adverb meaning with great speed.

clue.text: Stored information somewhat frowned at, as ethnocentric

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Recorded data rather disapproved of as culturally biased.
explanation.definitionFit: A dataset is a structured collection of data kept for processing.

clue.text: Bill and Will to share black jacket

indicators.note: to share means the two words use one letter in common rather than two

parts.note: a tab is a bill
Will Shakespeare is known as the Bard
B is the pencil abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: Two men named Bill and Will share a dark coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabard is a sleeveless tunic or jacket, as worn by heralds.

clue.text: Step-brothers turned back having dropped penny sweets

indicators.note: turned back means read in reverse
having dropped means the penny letter is let go

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Stepbrothers who lost a penny turn round and leave their sweets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having dropped' takes P out of STEPBROS to leave STEBROS, and 'turned back' reads that backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorbets are frozen fruit desserts, a kind of sweet course.

clue.text: Endurance adds dynamism to flips when energy's gone

indicators.note: gone means the energy letter is no longer there
flips means the word is turned over and read the other way

parts.note: animates means adds life or dynamism to
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Stamina gives energy to gymnastic flips until the energy runs out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flips' reverses ANIMATES to SETAMINA, and 'gone' removes its E.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamina is staying power, the ability to keep going.

clue.text: Vessel NATO designed to carry second missile

indicators.note: to carry means the rearranged letters hold the next pieces inside
designed means the letters of NATO are arranged anew

parts.note: an arrow is a missile
B is the second letter or second class

explanation.surface: The military alliance plans a ship carrying a second missile.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram splits around the inserted pieces, so the shuffled letters of NATO end up on both sides of the missile.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrowboat is a long thin canal boat, a type of vessel.

clue.text: Alpen possibly a name that evokes mountains

indicators.note: possibly says the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: The muesli brand Alpen was named to suggest the Alps.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepal is the Himalayan country home to Everest, so its name calls mountains to mind.

clue.text: I agree with you, I see

parts.note: ye is an old form of you
ah is an exclamation of understanding

explanation.surface: Someone nodding along in conversation.
explanation.definitionFit: Yeah is casual speech for yes, an expression of assent.

clue.text: African ruler acted lead in Othello

parts.note: did means acted

indicators.note: lead in means take the first letter of Othello

explanation.surface: An actor played the title role in a Shakespeare tragedy set partly in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Dido was the legendary founding queen of Carthage in North Africa.

clue.text: Drunk given watered shot felt hurt and quit, perhaps

definitions.text: Drunk given watered shot felt hurt and quit, perhaps

parts.words: Drunk given watered shot felt hurt and quit, perhaps
parts.note: every word except perhaps and and is a verb form of the kind used after have, as in have drunk, have given

explanation.walkthrough: The surface is a drinker's sad story; read grammatically, each word is an example of the same verb form.
explanation.definitionFit: Drunk, given, watered and the rest are the forms used with have to make perfect tenses.

clue.text: Relative security for the UK

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the Secret Intelligence Service, Britain's foreign intelligence agency (MI6)

explanation.walkthrough: SIS is the Secret Intelligence Service, better known as MI6.
explanation.definitionFit: A sister is a family member, and the agency protects Britain's national security.

clue.text: Heat on, producing glow

parts.note: heat as in an animal on heat suggests sexual desire, lust
re means on or about, regarding

explanation.surface: Turning up the heater makes things glow.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre is a soft reflected shine, a kind of glow.

clue.text: Spoon fairly close to a bit of pasta

parts.note: ca, for circa, means approximately, fairly close to a figure
a noodle is a strand of pasta

explanation.surface: A spoon brought near a piece of pasta at dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoon is the old verb meaning to kiss and cuddle, not the utensil.
explanation.definitionFit: To spoon and to canoodle both mean to kiss and cuddle amorously.
